findings.title: deepMerge is vulnerable to prototype pollution
findings.description: deepMerge recurses into every own key of attacker-controlled JSON, including `__proto__` (JSON.parse creates it as an own key) and `constructor`, so target['__proto__'] resolves to Object.prototype and the merge writes properties onto it. Skip the keys `__proto__`, `constructor` and `prototype`, or merge into Object.create(null).
findings.suggestion: Add `if (key === '__proto__' || key === 'constructor' || key === 'prototype') continue;` at the top of the loop.
